verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an eSignature REST API for requesting signatures and automating forms (docusign-docs-21, docusign-docs-22). It also ships an official Node.js client to send, sign and approve documents (docusign-docs-40) and publishes OpenAPI specs on GitHub (docusign-gh-1, docusign-gh-3). Hands-on developers report building envelope and embedded-signing integrations quickly and praise the documentation's thoroughness (docusign-comm-4, docusign-comm-5), though one team hit an embedded-signing session issue that required a legacy API version (docusign-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that document generation and template/data population are exposed through the API rather than only through CLM and Salesforce product features, and the OpenAPI spec is not served from the developer site.
